name: MXRead
summary: MXRead is a mixed reality reading companion for people who want the feel of paper books with the flexibility of digital annotation. In mixed reality, you can highlight passages, write or draw in 3D space, place virtual sticky notes, and record voice notes directly onto physical books. Page-linked annotations use QR-based tracking, so your notes stay connected to the page as you read and turn pages.
